items.stem: When does the checklist recommend completing Executive Validation pre-work?

options.text: One to three business days before the meeting.
Only after a full pilot is finished.
Never; all preparation should be live.
Exactly eighteen months in advance.

items.stem: Only the champion attends the executive readout. What should the team do?

options.text: Assume the champion has signature authority.
Start a pilot without further checks.
Record Economic Buyer approval anyway.
Treat it as preparation and obtain the actual sponsor decision separately.

items.stem: How much initial Glean repositioning does the PDF suggest at most?

options.text: The entire 60-minute session.
At least 45 minutes before discussing workflows.
About five minutes, especially for a new executive audience.
No customer context at all.

items.stem: A CFO says the estimate is not realized savings. What is the best answer?

options.text: Remove the caveats to make the deck persuasive.
Blame the customer for asking about evidence.
Insist every presale model is a confirmed result.
Agree, show the labeled assumptions and define what evidence will validate the case.

items.stem: The sponsor wants proof of one workflow. What should guide the validation choice?

options.text: The lightest sufficient event that answers the unresolved buying question.
An environment selected without security or data review.
The option with the most connectors regardless of need.
Always the longest available pilot.

items.stem: What belongs in same-day to 24-hour follow-up?

options.text: Only a thank-you GIF.
A statement that security is complete without review.
Decisions, success criteria, validation path, owners, timeline and updated records.
Internal account scores sent broadly to the customer.

items.stem: What should an executive success criterion include?

options.text: A defined metric/quality threshold, owner, evidence source and timeframe.
Only the vendor's enthusiasm.
Only the word successful.
A retrospective target chosen after seeing results.

items.stem: The sponsor accepts value but not the permission-sensitive future state. What should be recorded?

options.text: Conditional acceptance plus a scoped technical validation dependency and owner.
A claim that permissions no longer matter.
Unconditional production approval.
A requirement to abandon all discovery evidence.
